Gauntlet Carry.name: Gauntlet Carry
Gauntlet Carry.description: The user, once adapted to fire, cold, floodwater or toxic gas, shields up to two people against their changed body and hauls them out of a burning room, flooded basement or gas-filled street. Blister-proof skin, frost-proof fat or gill-fed breaths take the hazard for those carried until they reach safety; overcorrection stiffens the user to a slow walk, unable to dodge blows. Strain: heavy.
